title: Pointwise CATE Rates for Low-Smoothness Nuisances via Density-Free Cross-Pair Estimation
banked_reason: kernel_substituted@thm:unified-benchmark-attainment: both promised constructions were replaced by the same order-one cross-pair estimator, while the required multiresolution correction remains open.
gap_reasons: The title and the name ‘rank-feasible local HOIF’ misdescribe the delivered method: the estimator is an order-one close-pair ratio containing no empirical Gram matrix, Möbius stabilization, or higher-order influence-function construction.
Attainment beyond alpha, beta, gamma at most one is also unproved, with only a saturated first-difference robustness bound available.
proof_attempt_summary: The run attempted the promised same-sample localized Möbius-HOIF and multiresolution close-pair branches, but the available literature did not discharge their projection-stability, causal-ratio, cancellation, and collision bounds. It instead proved a sound explicit clipped order-one cross-pair risk bound on 0 < alpha,beta,gamma <= 1, including a reversed nuisance-order open set and an above-elbow positive-band minimax corollary. That result cannot satisfy the accepted method-level field claim: both branch handles use the same pair estimator, while the higher-order multiresolution construction remains open and the general referee grades the delivered package subfield.
tldr: On \(\mathcal R_{\mathrm{pair}}=\{0<\alpha,\beta,\gamma\leq1\}\), one bounded density-free cross-pair estimator attains the optimizer-defined three-term objective without logarithmic loss.  With \(s=(\alpha+\beta)/2\) and \(s_0=d\gamma/\{2(2\gamma+d)\}\), that objective has order \(n^{-1/\{1+d/(2\gamma)+d/(4s)\}}\) below the elbow and \(n^{-\gamma/(2\gamma+d)}\) at and above it.  A uniform-design Bernoulli two-point submodel proves the positive-band lower rate \(n^{-\gamma/(2\gamma+d)}\), so the latter is the positive-band minimax rate when \(s\geq s_0\).  Below the elbow the former is an attained upper benchmark, while a matching positive-band converse remains unresolved.  The order-one region includes \(U=\{0<\alpha<\beta<\gamma<1\}\) outside the banked region.
gap: KBRW publish the sharp pointwise-CATE benchmark and an upper theorem with a local covariate-law condition. It is unresolved whether that same three-term objective is attainable without density estimation or a density-ratio condition after explicitly restricting attention to laws with a fixed positive two-sided density band. Existing density-free empirical HOIF results are global and rank-limited, while close-pair results target noncausal variance functionals.
fill: On the fixed positive-band class, the project derives both branch constructions, proves the KBRW three-term risk envelope without density estimation, a density-ratio condition, or logarithmic loss, extends the close-pair smoothness region, and combines the branches through the deterministic exhaustive selector \((G_n,P_n)\) with bounded fallbacks.
